## Start here

This hub follows the authoritative TEJ hardware-module sequence. H01 is the first complete module package. Programming, Linux, and systems have planned curricular scope but remain **Later** for implementation.

## Formula and calculator centre

::: {.tej-download-grid}
::: {.tej-download-card}
### Electronics formula reference

SI prefixes through measurement safety, with true mathematical subscripts and verified Casio fx-991ES PLUS C procedures.

[Open accessible HTML](https://mrandrewandrade.github.io/assets/TEJ-Electronics-Formula-Reference.html){target="_blank"}<br>
[Download formula-reference PDF](https://mrandrewandrade.github.io/assets/TEJ-Electronics-Formula-Reference.pdf){target="_blank"}<br>
[View maintained QMD source](https://github.com/mrandrewandrade/assets/blob/master/electronics/reference/TEJ-Electronics-Formula-Reference.qmd){target="_blank"}
:::

::: {.tej-download-card}
### Basic circuit calculations

Ten questions: Q1 to Q5 required, Q6 to Q10 optional Level 4 evidence.

[Download student worksheet](https://mrandrewandrade.github.io/assets/TEJ_Basic_Circuit_Calculations_Student_Worksheet.pdf){target="_blank"}<br>
[Teacher answer key, restricted](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Ux3gAje5iED6vO_gBcF7SbaBJ5TJkV5RqJmkc6XFtDw/edit){target="_blank"}
:::
